reader.requirement: DISPLAY transfers the content of each identifier or literal operand to the device in the order written, with an implementor-defined conversion.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses END-DISPLAY and a numeric DISPLAY literal that is not an unsigned integer below 2002 (SR2 and a later form, not the transfer)
the national and boolean literal rows that refuse N".." and B".." operands at 85 (operand class, not the transfer)

reader.edition-search: grep of AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, AcceptDisplayBinder.cs and OperandText.cs for Edition, DialectLevel, DialectBehavior, CobolVersion: the transfer (BoundDisplay to Console.Write or WriteLine of the concatenated device strings) consults no edition; the numeric device form is the --numeric-display option (EditionContext.NumericDisplay, default Decimal), not an edition switch. The only edition sites on the DISPLAY path are compile-time refusals of later forms.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the transfer is the same code at every edition; only the admitted operand forms (signed numeric literal, national and boolean literals, END-DISPLAY) differ
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers alphanumeric and an unsigned numeric item; groups, ODO, signed, scaled, edited and COMP items, figurative constants and function operands are not exercised

probes.printed: G=[AB00701K] / GS=[-012] GN=[007] / T=[XYZ] (ODO at 3) / T13=[XYZ] T33=[Z] / SC=[1.25] SP=[300] SPL=[.003] / ED=[  4.50-] CMP=[-0321] / BIG=[-999999999999999999] ZR=[000] SEP=[-005] / SPACE=[ ] ZERO=[0] QUOTE=["] ALL=[AB] HV=[*] / 200 L on one line / U1U2 / ABAB| / LAST (no trailing newline); stdout byte-identical at --std 2023
probes.expected: each operand transferred whole in order (GR1, GR4, GR6), a figurative constant once (GR3), NO ADVANCING leaves the position after the last character (GR8), a new line otherwise (GR9); numeric conversion implementor-defined (DOC-A.1-56)

probes.printed: COBOL0900 for DISPLAY -1 (SR2), N"AB" and B"1" (2002 literal classes); DISPLAY W NO ADVANCING (WITH omitted) accepted
probes.expected: SR2 and the 1985 literal classes refuse them; WITH is optional

probes.expected: alphanumeric function operands and subscripted / ref-modified operands transferred in order; after NO ADVANCING the next DISPLAY continues the line

reader.notes: The emitter concatenates each operand's device string left to right into one Console.Write or WriteLine; a group sends its storage image, a numeric item the decimal device form documented as DOC-A.1-56. Output identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: s1.cob (s1-001, od of stdout): an ODO group at 0 occurrences transfers nothing then a line end, LOW-VALUE bytes and a COMP item inside a group transferred as their bytes (NUL NUL NUL; A NUL 001 B), operands in order, figurative constants once (ZERO ZERO SPACE QUOTE gives 00 and a quote; ALL 'XY' ALL SPACES gives XY and one space). s2_1..s2_9 at --std 85: DISPLAY 1.5 and DISPLAY +5 refused COBOL0900 (SR2), DISPLAY of a USAGE INDEX item refused COBOL1694, UPON ENVIRONMENT-NAME, an undeclared SYSERR and a data-name refused COBOL0817, AT LINE (later screen format) refused COBOL1707, ON EXCEPTION refused COBOL2269. s3.cob: UPON a SYSERR mnemonic goes to stderr in order. No missed edition site. cite.py: OK  §1985:VI.6.10.4 GR1 (the text is in GR1); OK  §1985:VI.6.10.3 SR2 (the text is in SR2)
